## Seller services
We review comparable sales and competing listings, recommend pricing and preparation, coordinate the agreed media scope, position eligible listings in the MLS, contact relevant buyer agents, review feedback and negotiate offers and closing terms.
A comparative market analysis is an estimate, not an appraisal or a guarantee of sale price.
We discuss the seller's next purchase, relocation and possible occupancy arrangements where appropriate. Terms require agreement and documentation. Attorneys and tax advisors handle legal and tax advice.

- [Seller research and transaction guides](https://homesprofessional.com/journal): Dated guides on pricing, net proceeds, homestead portability, 1031 exchanges, FIRPTA and post-closing occupancy.
- [Palm Beach County Real Estate Market 2026–2027: Boca Raton, Delray & West Palm Guide](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/palm-beach-county-real-estate-market-2026-2027-guide) (2026-11-27 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): October 2026 Palm Beach County MIAMI REALTORS® benchmarks ($682,500 SFH +6.1% YoY at 3.9 months supply and 45.9% cash; $300,000 condo -4.8% YoY at 7.1 months supply and 59.7% cash with +0.5% YoY sales), Q2 2026 city spreads (Boca Raton $1.30M, Palm Beach Gardens $1.15M, Jupiter $1.10M, Delray Beach $800K, West Palm Beach $651K), 7.21% rates, $855,400 2027 loan limits, Citizens -11.7% HO-3 cuts, and FHFA repeat-sales context (`ATNHPIUS12099A` 10.48x 1975–2025).
- [Florida 2027 Online Listing Property Tax Law: South Florida Guide](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/florida-2027-online-listing-property-tax-estimate-law-south-florida) (2026-11-26 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): February 1, 2027 Fla. Stat. § 689.261 (HB 7031E) prohibition against portals using sellers' Save Our Homes-capped tax bills, listing-price millage formulas, Amendment 3 residency timing (Dec 31, 2026 cutoff), 7.21% Freddie Mac PMMS rates (Nov 25, 2026), and tri-county submarket seller steps.
- [Florida Citizens 2027 Flood Insurance Mandate: South Florida Seller & Buyer Guide](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/florida-citizens-2027-flood-insurance-mandate-south-florida-sellers) (2026-11-26 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): Final January 1, 2027 phase of Florida Statutes § 627.351(6) requiring separate flood insurance on all remaining Citizens personal wind policies (including FEMA Zone X), HO-6 condo exemption, 2026 OIR Citizens HO-3 rate reductions (-13.0% Miami-Dade, -12.6% Broward, -11.7% Palm Beach), 20% private-carrier takeout rule, and pre-listing seller insurance preparation.
- [South Florida 2027 Conforming Loan Limits ($855,400): Buyer and Seller Guide](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/south-florida-2027-conforming-loan-limits-855400-guide) (2026-11-25 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): FHFA 2027 conforming loan limits for Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach ($855,400 1-unit, $1,095,250 2-unit, $1,323,900 3-unit, $1,645,350 4-unit effective Jan 1, 2027), purchase-price ceilings from $900,421 (5% down) to $1,140,533 (25% down), Jumbo reserve overlays, condo warrantability checks, and seller pricing strategy.
- [South Florida New Construction vs. Resale: Rate Buydowns and Seller Concessions (2026)](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/south-florida-new-construction-vs-resale-rate-buydowns-2026) (2026-11-24 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): Exact math comparing a $20,000 asking price cut (-$109/mo P&I) vs. a ~$13,218 seller-funded 2-1 rate buydown (-$729/mo Yr 1, -$373/mo Yr 2) on a $700K South Florida home at 7.28% rates, Fannie Mae B3-4.1-02 IPC caps (3%/6%/9% by LTV, 2% investment) and FHA 6% cap, plus new-construction CDD, tax reset, and Dec 31, 2026 Amendment 3 residency checks.
- [South Florida Condo Warrantability & Fannie Mae Full Review (2026)](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/south-florida-condo-warrantability-fannie-mae-full-review-2026) (2026-11-23 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): Dual buyer/seller guide to Fannie Mae Full Review (Form 1076), 0.9% tri-county FHA condo approval (21 of 2,397 buildings), December 31, 2026 SIRS statutory cutoff (HB 913 $25,000 threshold), October 2026 condo medians ($397.5K Miami-Dade / $240.3K Broward / $300K Palm Beach), 82% $1M+ Miami condo cash share, and -10.4% Citizens HO-6 rate reductions.
- [Should You Sell Your South Florida Home Now or Wait Until 2027?](https://homesprofessional.com/journal/sell-south-florida-home-now-or-wait-until-2027) (2026-11-22 · Carlos Uzcategui · Florida Licensed Realtor® SL705771): October 2026 tri-county medians (Miami-Dade $706K SFH / $397.5K condo at 12.7 mos supply, Broward $610K SFH / $240.3K condo with 1.2% distressed share, Palm Beach $682.5K SFH with >20% MoM winter inventory jump), 7.28% 30-year fixed rates, 2026 Citizens rate decreases (-8.7% HO-3, -10.4% HO-6), and 50-year FHFA repeat-sales baseline (18.07x Greater Miami vs. 11.55x U.S.).

## First step
Request a private seller strategy review at https://homesprofessional.com/sell#contact or contact Carlos on U.S. WhatsApp. Share the property address, contact details, timing and priorities. Carlos reviews the information and contacts you to arrange the conversation. No fee for the review and no listing commitment.

## Limits
MLS visibility, syndication and referral reach depend on property eligibility, applicable rules, brokerage approval and participating channels. No guaranteed placement, agent attention, inquiries, referrals, price, sale or closing timeline. Current figures and claims must be checked against the dated sources on the relevant page.
